# Tire carrier hinge placement and weight distribution

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Position the spare tire on the passenger side closest to the hinge. [t1638]

## Tips & gotchas

- Mounting the tire passenger side reduces stress on a cantilevered hinge. [t1638]
- This placement keeps weight closer to the hinge pivot point. [t1638]
